description: Throwaway engine test for gated doors: a facilities worker on a multi-room round opens a staff-only door, closes it behind a visitor who is not allowed through, and reopens it next lap. Generic office, nothing to solve.
test_objective: Verify door gates (open for the NPC, hold, shut, never trap), multi-room route with unlockRoom/useObject/dwellTime, sight challenge near the door with closeDoor, playerMayPassIf via a visitor lanyard, clone-as-entry with the RFID cloner, and reopening without a room reload
